mapper.select: SELECT i.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS name, COUNT(i.id) AS cnt FROM t_item i JOIN t_category c ON c.id = i.category_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 'ON_SALE' GROUP BY i.category_id, c.name ORDER BY cnt DESC
SELECT i.category_id AS categoryId, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_item i WHERE i.deleted = 0 GROUP BY i.category_id

SELECT o.amount FROM t_order o WHERE o.deleted = 0 AND o.status = 'DONE' AND o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
AND o.item_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY o.amount ASC

SELECT i.id AS id, i.title AS title, i.cover_image AS coverImage, i.price AS price, i.category_id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, i.seller_id AS sellerId, u.nickname AS sellerNickname, i.campus AS campus, i.status AS status, i.reject_reason AS rejectReason, i.created_at AS createdAt FROM t_item i LEFT JOIN t_category c ON c.id = i.category_id LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = i.seller_id WHERE i.deleted = 0
AND i.status = #{q.status}
AND i.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY i.created_at ASC, i.id ASC

SELECT i.id AS id, i.title AS title, i.cover_image AS coverImage, i.price AS price, i.seller_id AS sellerId, u.nickname AS sellerNickname, i.campus AS campus, i.status AS status, i.created_at AS createdAt FROM t_item i LEFT JOIN t_user u ON u.id = i.seller_id WHERE i.deleted = 0 AND i.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY i.created_at ASC, i.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
